About the book

Your Good Girl has been running the show. It’s time to meet her.

Good Girl, Goodbye introduces 12 archetypes, representing the different ways we’ve learned to earn approval, stay safe and feel like we belong.

Be nice.
Don’t be difficult.
Work harder.
Keep everyone happy.
Don’t ask for too much.
Be grateful.
Smile.
Don’t make a fuss.

Sound familiar? These are some of the scripts many of us learned growing up.

The quiz will reveal the Good Girl that dominates your behaviour so you can recognise the patterns and start to untangle from her.

Because once you can name her, you can choose something different.

About Caitlin

Meet the Author

I’m the author of Good Girl, Goodbye — a book exploring the invisible expectations that shape women’s lives and what it takes to rewrite them.

The 12 Good Girl archetypes in this quiz are based on years of research, interviews and lived experience, and have helped thousands of women recognise patterns they never had words for.

This quiz is your first step.
